newsitem.title: USA: At least 10 reported dead in Calif. mass suicide.
newsitem.headline: At least 10 reported dead in Calif. mass suicide.

text.p: Deputies found at least 10 bodies at the scene of an apparent mass suicide, a local TV station reported on Wednesday.

The station, KFMB quoted a reporter at the scene as saying the bodies were in a "multi-million-dollar house" in Rancho Santa Fe, some 20 miles (32 km) north of San Diego. The San Diego County Sheriff's Department had no immediate comment.
